logic.momentum_entry: At newly closed 4h bar i, enter only if close[i-1] > close[i-1-lookback_4h_bars], strictly positive momentum.
logic.relative_volume_entry: On same decision, quote_volume[i-1] / arithmetic_mean(quote_volume at same UTC 4h slot from prior 20 days, indices i-7 through i-121 step -6) >= configured threshold. Current bar excluded.
logic.exit: If long, set desired cash whenever close[i-1] <= close[i-1-lookback_4h_bars], regardless of volume. Exit has priority; otherwise enter on both entry conditions; all other cases preserve desired state.
logic.timing: Signals only use completed UTC 4h bars. Execute on the next UTC 4h block first one-minute open, block_start+60 seconds.
logic.sizing: Independent $2,000 unlevered spot account; max affordable LOT_SIZE entry, exit all valid units; preserve cash; no rebalance, add-on, leverage, short, yield, or pre-OOS fills.
